description:
**Release candidate — please report problems before 1.9.0.**

### New
- **Reddit image hosting**: upload images, GIFs and videos straight to Reddit in posts, comment replies, comment edits and post bodies, replacing rif's broken imgur hosting. (#5)
- **Fix history import**: "Import settings" restores your history from backups made with "Export settings and history". Thanks to @Arnaumes. (#6)
- **Post to profile**: a My Profile button on the submit page, and Submit in your profile's menu.
- **Explain Reddit blocks**: shows "Reddit is temporarily blocking requests" instead of "Error: forbidden" when Reddit blocks a feed. (#7)

### Fixes
- The outdated warnings about editing the text of link posts are gone.
- No more slight screen jump after scrolling past an inline video.
- Inline images that failed to load are retried instead of staying broken until rif restarts.
- Text after an inline image in a text post is no longer drawn over the image.
- i.redd.it links starting with a capital `Https://` show inline.

### Adding this bundle
To try this release candidate, add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MojiRS/revanced-rif-patches/main/bundles/latest.json` as a remote patch source in ReVanced Manager (`stable.json` stays on 1.8.0 until 1.9.0). Requires rif is fun **5.6.22** (free or Golden Platinum), patched together with the official ReVanced bundle's **Spoof client** patch. [notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes](https://github.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes) is needed alongside it to fix galleries and loading more comments.
